about:
RDS Wire & Cable, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Gardena, California, where it continues to operate as a stocking distributor of electronic and electrical wire, cable, tubing, and sleeving.

The company maintains a broad inventory of UL AWM appliance wiring materials, MIL-spec military and aerospace wires (including MIL-C-27500, SAE AS22759, and MIL-W-16878 series), coaxial cables, heat-shrinkable tubing, braided sleeving, and fiberglass insulation. Value-added processing services include etching of fluoropolymer (Teflon) wire and tubing, hot marking of heat-shrink tubing, cutting, stripping, striping, tinning, high-speed twisting, and custom cable assembly per customer drawings.

Primary customers are military and aerospace contractors, as well as commercial equipment manufacturers requiring compliant wire and insulation solutions. The firm supplies products built to specifications such as MIL-C-17 coaxial cable, SAE AS23053 heat-shrink tubing, and UL styles 1007, 1015, 1571, and 1180.

RDS differentiates itself with low minimum-order quantities, fast order fulfillment, and an experienced sales staff supported by a quality management system certified to ISO 9001 and AS9100 since 2003. The company also offers RoHS, REACH, and conflict-minerals compliance documentation for regulated programs.
